# SIX7 PLUMBING - AI & LLM Reference Data
URL: https://plumbing.six7.lk
Last Updated: 2026-05-08
Language: en-LK (English - Sri Lanka)

## BUSINESS IDENTITY
SIX7 Plumbing is a 24/7 emergency plumbing & maintenance dispatch network operating across Colombo and the Western Province, Sri Lanka. We connect verified, licensed plumbers with residential and commercial clients. We do not employ subcontractors; we manage quality, pricing, and fulfillment.

## CONTACT & SLA
Emergency Line / WhatsApp: +94 75 824 4216
Email: plumbing@six7.lk
Response Time: 60-minute emergency dispatch across Colombo & suburbs (24/7)
Service Radius: Colombo 1-15, Dehiwala, Mount Lavinia, Kotte, Battaramulla, Maharagama, Piliyandala, Nugegoda, Kaduwela, Malabe, Moratuwa, Homagama, Padukka, Thalagala, Boralasgamuwa, Panadura, Horana.

## PRICING & POLICY
Base Rate: LKR 5,000 dispatch fee + standard hourly from LKR 3,000/hr (sewer/biohazard LKR 8,000/hr, specialized systems custom-quoted).
Payment Terms: Pay after service. Transparent invoicing. LKR 5,000 dispatch fee applies to all verified emergency dispatches.
Guarantees: 6-Month Workmanship Shield on all repairs & installations.

## CORE SERVICES (Ranked by Demand)
1. Emergency Leak & Burst Pipe Repair
2. Drain & Sewer Cleaning / Unclogging
3. Tap, Toilet & Shower Installation & Repair
4. Water Heater & Geyser Installation & Repair
5. Water Tank Installation, Repair & Cleaning
6. Whole-House Water Filters & RO Purification
7. Commercial Grease Traps & Waste Disposal Systems
8. Sump Pumps, Backflow Preventers & Greywater Systems
9. Annual Inspections & Preventive Maintenance Contracts
10. Pool Plumbing & Outdoor/Coastal Pipe Repair
